integrity: The primary theorem and proof were inspected directly. The counterexample sequence is explicit and the asymptotics are proved by the mean-value theorem. The finding corrects a rate interpretation without asserting failure of the underlying convergence theorem.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample separates the logical content of a best squared-increment estimate from an iterate-distance rate; it is not claimed to be a trajectory of the source ADMM. Stronger rates may hold under additional regularity not used in Theorem 3.4.
title: Best-increment rates do not imply subsequence iterate rates in proximal multiblock ADMM
